

## Hypothesis

H1: Women will score higher on intensity of love compared to men.

H2: Overall romantic love will positively correlate with relationship duration.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data

getwd(
)
h1Data<- read.csv("/Users/anegrette/Downloads/PSY221A_Negrette/Data/processed_data/h1.csv")
h2Data<- read.csv("/Users/anegrette/Downloads/PSY221A_Negrette/Data/processed_data/h2.csv")
#reorganize categorical variable
h1Data$Sex <- factor(h1Data$Sex,
                           levels=c("Men","Women","Prefer not to say"))

```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.

h1Data <- na.omit(h1Data)
h1Box <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=Sex,
                    y=Love_how_much_1,
                    fill=Sex)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x="Gender",
       y="Love Intesnity",
       fill="Gender",
       title="Love Intesnity by Gender")+
  theme_gray(base_size=15)

h1Box






```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.

h1Viol <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                 aes(x=Sex,
                    y=Love_how_much_1,
                    fill=Sex))+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_boxplot(width=.20)+
labs(x="Gender",
       y="Love Intesnity",
       fill="Gender",
       title="Love Intensity by Gender")+
  theme_gray(base_size=15)

h1Viol


```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot

```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.
h1Rain <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                 aes(x=Sex,
                    y=Love_how_much_1,
                    fill=Sex))+
  geom_rain(alpha = .5)+
  labs(x="Gender",
       y="Love Intesnity",
       fill="Gender",
       title="Love Intesnity by Gender")+
  theme_gray(base_size=12)

h1Rain
  
```

## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}

h2Data <- na.omit(h2Data)
#Scatter Plot
h2Points <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                    aes(x=Relationship_length,
                        y=all_love_score))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x="Relationship Length",
       y="Overall Romantic Love",
       title="Overall Romantic Love and Relationship Length")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 18)

h2Points

#Jitter
h2Jitter <- ggplot(
  data=h2Data,
                    aes(x=Relationship_length,
                        y=all_love_score))+
    geom_jitter(width = .12,height=.04,alpha=.04,size = .6)+
    labs(x="Relationship Length",
       y="Overall Romantic Love",
       title="Overall Romantic Love and Relationship Length")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 18)


h2Jitter




```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2Jitter + geom_smooth(method="lm")

h2Line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures",showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("figures/h1_h1Box.png",plot=h1Box,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/h2_scatter.png",plot=h2Line,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
```
